attachments_target_matches_kind.name: attachments_target_matches_kind
attachments_target_matches_kind.value:
("attachments"."kind" = 'PROJECT' AND "attachments"."task_id" IS NULL AND "attachments"."payment_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("attachments"."kind" = 'TASK' AND "attachments"."task_id" IS NOT NULL AND "attachments"."payment_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("attachments"."kind" = 'PAYMENT' AND "attachments"."payment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "attachments"."task_id" IS NULL)

customer_contacts_reachable.name: customer_contacts_reachable
customer_contacts_reachable.value: "customer_contacts"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "customer_contacts"."phone" IS NOT NULL

invoice_lines_period.name: invoice_lines_period
invoice_lines_period.value:
("invoice_lines"."subscription_id" IS NULL AND "invoice_lines"."period_start" IS NULL AND "invoice_lines"."period_end" IS NULL)
       OR ("invoice_lines"."subscription_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_lines"."period_start" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_lines"."period_end" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_lines"."period_end" >= "invoice_lines"."period_start")

invoice_payments_void_complete.name: invoice_payments_void_complete
invoice_payments_void_complete.value:
("invoice_payments"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "invoice_payments"."voided_by" IS NULL AND "invoice_payments"."void_reason" IS NULL)
       OR ("invoice_payments"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_payments"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(coalesce("invoice_payments"."void_reason", ''))) >= 3)

invoices_issued_complete.name: invoices_issued_complete
invoices_issued_complete.value: "invoices"."status" = 'DRAFT' OR ("invoices"."number" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."issue_date" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."due_date" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."issued_at" IS NOT NULL)

invoices_due_after_issue.name: invoices_due_after_issue
invoices_due_after_issue.value: "invoices"."due_date" IS NULL OR "invoices"."issue_date" IS NULL OR "invoices"."due_date" >= "invoices"."issue_date"

invoices_void_complete.name: invoices_void_complete
invoices_void_complete.value: ("invoices"."status" = 'VOID') = ("invoices"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(coalesce("invoices"."void_reason", ''))) >= 3)

payout_periods_locked_by.name: payout_periods_locked_by
payout_periods_locked_by.value: NOT "payout_periods"."locked" OR ("payout_periods"."locked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payout_periods"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL)

payout_questions_resolved_has_resolution.name: payout_questions_resolved_has_resolution
payout_questions_resolved_has_resolution.value: "payout_questions"."status" <> 'RESOLVED' OR ("payout_questions"."resolution" IS NOT NULL AND "payout_questions"."resolved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payout_questions"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

project_assignments_split_value_matches_.name: project_assignments_split_value_matches_type
project_assignments_split_value_matches_.value:
("project_assignments"."split_type" = 'PERCENTAGE' AND "project_assignments"."split_basis_points" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "project_assignments"."split_amount_minor" IS NULL)
       OR ("project_assignments"."split_type" = 'FIXED_AMOUNT' AND "project_assignments"."split_amount_minor" >= 0 AND "project_assignments"."split_basis_points" IS NULL)

project_costs_void_complete.name: project_costs_void_complete
project_costs_void_complete.value:
("project_costs"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "project_costs"."voided_by" IS NULL AND "project_costs"."void_reason" IS NULL)
       OR ("project_costs"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "project_costs"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(coalesce("project_costs"."void_reason", ''))) >= 3)

projects_health_override_has_reason.name: projects_health_override_has_reason
projects_health_override_has_reason.value:
("projects"."health_override" IS NULL AND "projects"."health_override_reason" IS NULL)
       OR ("projects"."health_override" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(coalesce("projects"."health_override_reason", ''))) >= 3 AND "projects"."health_override_by" IS NOT NULL)

subscriptions_renewal_in_term.name: subscriptions_renewal_in_term
subscriptions_renewal_in_term.value: "subscriptions"."renewal_date" IS NULL OR ("subscriptions"."renewal_date" >= "subscriptions"."start_date" AND ("subscriptions"."end_date" IS NULL OR "subscriptions"."renewal_date" <= "subscriptions"."end_date"))

tasks_done_requires_note.name: tasks_done_requires_note
tasks_done_requires_note.value: "tasks"."status" <> 'DONE' OR ("tasks"."completion_note" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

tasks_blocked_requires_reason.name: tasks_blocked_requires_reason
tasks_blocked_requires_reason.value: "tasks"."status" <> 'BLOCKED' OR ("tasks"."blocked_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."blocked_needs" IS NOT NULL)
